data: In fiscal 2024, which ended January 28, 2024, NVIDIA reported revenue of $60,922 million, up from $26,974 million in fiscal 2023. Cost of revenue was $16,621 million, leaving gross profit of $44,301 million, a gross margin of about 72.7% (fiscal 2023 was about 56.9%). Total operating expenses were $11,329 million, made up mainly of $8,675 million in research and development and $2,654 million in sales, general and administrative. That produced operating income of $32,972 million, an operating margin of about 54.1%, compared with roughly 15.7% in fiscal 2023. The fiscal 2023 figure was depressed by a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost.
